subject: Re: Kickoff: cold posteriors & calibrated serving
body:
Hi both,

Status: figures 1-3 reproduce. Our SG-MCMC chains confirm the headline: at temperature T=1 (the true Bayes posterior) the posterior predictive underperforms the SGD point estimate on CIFAR-10 ResNet-20, and cooling to T around 1e-3 gives the best accuracy — the cold-posterior effect is robust on our stack.

Hypothesis experiments underway: prior misspecification looks like the strongest explanation on our internal models; the data-augmentation hypothesis also moves the effect noticeably.

Trade-off for the memo: cold posteriors give better point accuracy but shrink predictive diversity, which is what our calibration story leans on. We may end up recommending different temperatures for accuracy-critical vs calibration-critical serving.

Risk: chain mixing on the internal models is slower than on CIFAR; the July sweep sizing assumed CIFAR-like mixing. Paloma is profiling.

Umar
